question: Which of the following countries was the runner-up in ICC Women's T20 World Cup – 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2020 ICC Women's T20 World Cup was the seventh ICC Women's T20 World Cup tournament.
 
• It was held between 21 February and 8 March 2020 in Melbourne, Australia.
 
• The final took place on International Women's Day.
 
• Australia won the tournament, beating India by 85 runs.​
 
• The tournament's leading run scorer and Player of the Series was Australian batter **Beth Mooney**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
